# OurMenu OS

> OurMenu OS is the universal digital operating system and SaaS platform for physical businesses, supermarkets & retail chains, hospitality venues, salons, spas, clinics, real estate agencies, and professional service providers. It unifies digital presence, customer ordering, operations, inventory, design customization, multi-branch fleet management, and multi-gateway billing.

## Core Platform Capabilities
- **Universal Design Tokens & 9 Multi-Templates**: Run digital menus, supermarket aisles, hotel bookings, real estate listings, and service rate cards under a unified portal. Portals dynamically adapt layouts (bento grid, masonry, list) and aesthetics (glassmorphism, neumorphism, flat) based on robust design tokens, with per-page overrides and a 1-click "Revert to Global Settings" fail-safe.
- **Enterprise Fleet & Multi-Branch Management**: Run physical branches (`locations`) across cities/regions from a single dashboard. Features a Top-Left Unified Switcher (Global View vs Branch/Department Tree), 1-click franchise catalog duplication (`duplicatePageAction`), and granular role-based access control (RBAC).
- **Tego Multimodal Live API (Voice & Vision)**: Ultra-low latency bidirectional voice dialogue (16kHz/24kHz with barge-in interruption) and 1 FPS camera video ingestion (`gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview`) using secure ephemeral tokens (`/api/ai/live-token`).
- **Frontline Business-Adaptive AI Assistant**: Domain-specific public assistant with strict zero-hallucination guardrails, public tool calling (cart modification, dietary filtering, slot booking, quote captures), and a real-time human handoff loop to the dashboard.
- **Native Raw ESC/POS Thermal Printing**: Zero-daemon direct binary receipt printing via WebUSB, WebSerial, and WebBluetooth with hardware cash drawer kicks and paper cuts.
- **Multi-Gateway Payment Integration**: End-to-end payment processing supporting Local & International Cards, Bank Transfers, and Crypto (USDC, USDT, SOL) via Paystack and Bachs.
- **Add-On Modules**: Gamified Lucky Wheel, Surprise Me Randomizer, In-house Delivery Rules, Deposit Billing, and IOU Customer Credit.
- **POS & Operations Board**: Real-time fulfillment tracking, staff shift scheduling, and manager kiosk mode.
